title: AI Spending Skyrockets: Meta's $50K/Employee AI Costs #shorts
description: Meta employees are burning through AI tokens at an astonishing rate, with one user consuming 280 billion tokens in 30 days! That's nearly $50,000 per employee. While most companies cap usage, power users are pushing limits, driving 70% of OpenAI and Anthropic's revenue. #AISpending #AIRevolution #TechNews #OpenAI #Meta
